- Chest X-ray findings (cardiothoracic ratio, pulmonary vascular markings) — to evaluate for pulmonary overcirculation or cardiomegaly.  
- Clinical assessment of capillary refill, peripheral pulses, and liver size — objective markers of systemic perfusion and volume overload.

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Patent ductus arteriosus
